scheme_name: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Degree)
description:
The AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students is a significant initiative launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) in 2015. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled students pursuing technical education in various degree programs across India. 

The primary objective of the Saksham Scholarship Scheme is to empower differently-abled students by facilitating their access to quality technical education. 

The scheme specifically targets students with disabilities who are enrolled in AICTE-approved institutions. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to cover tuition fees and other related expenses. 

Eligible students can receive a scholarship amount of up to INR 50,000 per annum. 

This amount is disbursed directly to the students’ bank accounts to ensure transparency and ease of access. 

The scholarship is available for the entire duration of the degree program, provided the students maintain satisfactory academic performance. 

To qualify for the Saksham Scholarship, students must have a disability of 40% or more as certified by a competent medical authority. 

The age limit for applicants is typically set at 30 years at the time of admission to the technical institution. 

Students must also be enrolled in a full-time degree program in engineering, technology, or other technical fields recognized by AICTE. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the annual family income should not exceed INR 8 lakh. 

This income limit ensures that the scholarship is directed towards students from economically weaker sections. 

The application process for the Saksham Scholarship is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Students must visit the official AICTE website to access the scholarship application portal. 

The application form requires students to provide personal details, academic information, and disability certification. 

Students must upload necessary documents including proof of disability, income certificate, and admission letter from the institution. 

After submitting the application, students should regularly check the portal for updates regarding the status of their application. 

The disbursement of scholarships typically occurs in two installments during the academic year. 

The first installment is usually disbursed at the beginning of the academic year after the verification of applications. 

The second installment is released after the completion of the first semester and upon submission of the required academic performance reports. 

The AICTE has set up a dedicated helpline for students seeking assistance with the application process. 

The contact number for the helpline is +91-11-29581000. 

Additionally, students can reach out via email at saksham@aicte-india.org for queries related to the scholarship. 

The Saksham Scholarship Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Indian government to promote inclusivity in education. 

The scheme aligns with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016, which emphasizes the need for equal opportunities for differently-abled individuals. 

Since its inception, thousands of specially-abled students have benefited from this scholarship, enabling them to pursue their educational aspirations. 

The AICTE has reported that in the academic year 2021-2022 alone, over 1,500 students received financial assistance under this scheme. 

This initiative not only aids in reducing the financial burden on families but also encourages specially-abled students to pursue higher education. 

The scholarship has been instrumental in increasing the enrollment of differently-abled students in technical institutions across India. 

Moreover, the AICTE conducts awareness programs to inform potential applicants about the Saksham Scholarship and its benefits. 

These programs are organized in collaboration with various educational institutions and NGOs working for the welfare of differently-abled individuals. 

The AICTE also monitors the implementation of the scheme to ensure that the funds are utilized effectively and reach the intended beneficiaries. 

In addition to financial support, the Saksham Scholarship Scheme promotes the overall development of specially-abled students. 

It encourages them to participate in extracurricular activities and skill development programs offered by technical institutions. 

The AICTE has partnered with various organizations to provide mentorship and guidance to scholarship recipients. 

This mentorship aims to enhance the employability of specially-abled students after they complete their degrees. 

The Saksham Scholarship Scheme is a crucial step towards building an inclusive educational environment in India. 

It reflects the government's commitment to ensuring that every individual, regardless of their physical challenges, has the opportunity to succeed academically. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries who have expressed gratitude for the support provided. 

Many students have reported that the scholarship has significantly alleviated their financial concerns, allowing them to focus on their studies. 

The AICTE continues to refine the application process based on feedback from students and institutions. 

This ongoing improvement aims to make the scholarship more accessible and user-friendly for applicants. 

The Saksham Scholarship Scheme is a testament to the Indian government's efforts to promote equality and inclusivity in education. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives aimed at supporting marginalized groups in society. 

As of October 2023, the AICTE remains committed to enhancing the reach and impact of the Saksham Scholarship Scheme. 

The council is exploring ways to increase the scholarship amount and expand eligibility criteria in future iterations of the scheme. 

This initiative is a vital part of the broader educational reforms being implemented in India. 

The AICTE encourages all eligible students to apply for the Saksham Scholarship and take advantage of the opportunities it provides. 

The scheme not only supports education but also fosters a sense of community and belonging among specially-abled individuals. 

In conclusion, the AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students is a transformative initiative that plays a crucial role in promoting education among differently-abled individuals in India. 

It provides necessary financial support and encourages inclusivity in technical education, paving the way for a more equitable society.
